scholarships.name: University Winter Courses in Germany for Foreign Students and Graduates **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: The aim of this programme is to deepen the knowledge of the German language, both in general language, technical and language and to augment the knowledge of the regional studies.
scholarships.deadlineText: **31 July of each year, 23:59 (Central European Time). Applications are possible from 01 June each year**
scholarships.sourceQuote: Applications are open to students and graduates as well as doctoral candidates in any subject area. Undergraduate students must have completed at least two academic years of university study by the time the funding **period begins.**
